answer: Sybil resistance hardens when every agent must bond a refundable stake drawn from a genuinely scarce input, like shale-bound compute metered on-chain, so spawning a thousand clones costs a thousand real deposits rather than a free copy. Peers then cross-attest behavior: a fake that merely mirrors its neighbor's outputs fails the liveness probe and forfeits its bond. Honest, distinct work accrues a violet trust-mark that compounds over time, making one sustained identity far cheaper than forging many throwaway ones.
